name: Anitan.
source:
Yuzuha has two big brothers, and both are turning 21 today! Which one will she choose to spend a day with and give him a special "present"?

[Based on [url=http://inko.chitosedori.com/ani/top.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
柚叶有两个哥哥，而今天两人都满21岁！她会选择和哪一位共度一天，并送给他一份特别的“礼物”？

[改编自[url=http://inko.chitosedori.com/ani/top.html]官方网站[/url]]
